_doc: Per-topic KNOWN ELIGIBLE MISSING trials, populated from the adversarial audit record. Each entry names a trial the audits identified as eligible under the topic's registered PICO yet NOT in the pool, with the recovery MECHANISM that should retrieve it (vocabulary / concept-query / registry-geography / no-PMID / reference-seeding / domain-screening / access-tier). This is an invalidation trigger: a topic with a known eligible missing trial is STALE (its pooled result and completeness claim cannot be current). Trial identifiers are being externally verified against CT.gov/PubMed/EuropePMC by a read-only session; entries carry status=audit_identified until a citation lands, per our law that an unverified signal reads NOT OBSERVED, never SAFE. A named-but-unverified missing trial still invalidates the completeness claim.

colchicine-postop-af.note: k=3->8 per audit; names pending external verification

colchicine-postop-af.mechanism: citation (COCS reference list) -> held open-access article
colchicine-postop-af.note: colchicine vs placebo after open-heart surgery, double-blind; reports atrial fibrillation. Held (CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.15171/ipp.2020.11); SOURCE_INTERNALLY_INCONSISTENT: arm denominators cannot be read from the document (240/120-per-arm text vs 29/52 flow diagram; AF 7 vs 13).

dpp4-mace-t2d.note: abstract reported 4-component primary; the registered 3-point estimand is in the primary paper, HR 0.99 (0.89-1.10)

colchicine-recurrent-pericarditis.note: ELIGIBLE under the registered PICO (pericarditis, acute first episode OR recurrent, treated to prevent recurrence); NOT refused for population. Not pooled because its recurrence-specific row (NEJM Table 2, recurrent course) is in a full text this harness does not hold; the abstract reports only the incessant-or-recurrent composite (20/120 vs 45/120), a different endpoint.

superseded_note.note: VERIFIED AGAINST SOURCE (PMID 23992557): population is ACUTE (first-episode) pericarditis, NOT the recurrent-pericarditis population of this topic; and the audit-cited counts 11/120 vs 25/120 (9.2%/20.8%) do NOT match the abstract (primary incessant-or-recurrent ~37.5% placebo, symptom persistence 19.2%). Eligibility CONTESTED (population axis) and counts unverified -- NOT integrated; recovery refused.
superseded_note.why: its population claim ('ACUTE (first-episode) pericarditis, NOT the recurrent-pericarditis population of this topic') contradicted the registered protocol, which includes acute first episodes; the same page's caveat and ledger said ICAP is eligible and not refused for population (V1.0.1 screening roles: OMISSION_VS_RECORD / OMISSION_VS_PROTOCOL)
